engine.description: The concrete database engine, inferred from the evidence (dependency manifest, config files, driver imports). Use "unknown" when the model/entity definition alone doesn't name one and no manifest/config evidence resolves it — never guess.

references.description: Only when this field is a foreign key to another entity returned in this same response — omit entirely otherwise, never guess.

target_entity.description: The `name` of the referenced entity, exactly as returned above.

unique.description: true when this field is also under a uniqueness constraint (one-to-one with the target), false for a regular many-to-one foreign key.
